title: 1RB1RA_1LC0LF_1RA1LD_1LB1LE_0LC0RD_---0RA: the model's long run is now checked in Lean
text: The stack model never gets stuck on the run, and the machine halts from blank tape exactly when the model does (halts_iff_model, kernel). A faster model, proved to be the machine, reruns c/wrun.c by native_decide: no halt in the first 2,097,152 visits, 13,274,338,602,369 steps. The Lean model and c/wrun.c agree at each of the first 65,536 visits and at every power of two.
